column2: GRAAAAAAAH!!
Is he going to fight them all by himself!?
Now this is fun! I'm itching like crazy to cut loose!
Akira-kun!?
I'm going too! We can't just let that giant die!
Why did you help me?
Why...? Well, I figured you'd get killed all on your own...
Wh-what?
What is your name...?
Get mixed up with me and you won't walk away clean.\n\nAre you fine with that!? {p}!!
...I sense an energy in you unlike any I've ever met. And... this place is Hell!
Hell...
How will you live in this Hell? I'll be watching.
Come to think of it, what happened to Takuma-kun?
Bet he got scared and ran off.
Let's go back to the village.
Wait, Jack!
You people, get out of this town!
It's all over... The Slum King is sure to come for revenge!
You're nothing but bad luck!
What did you say...!
Grown-ups, I swear!\n\nIf {p} and the others hadn't beaten the Dragons, this town would've been torn to pieces by them!
Takuma-kun?
You'd run off the minute things got bad, so don't act so big!
Ugh...
Thanks, Takuma-kun!
I was just impressed by the guts it took to stand up to the Dragons! You should come to the Quake Fort too! You're welcome there!
The Quake Fort?
A fort for kids who lost their parents in the Kanto Hellquake, just kids! Or have you got someplace else to go?
Actually...
Huh... What a strange story...\n\nSo {p} and the rest of you don't know about the Kanto Hellquake... I'm kinda jealous.
I watched lots of people I loved die right in front of me. And we couldn't do anything...
Takuma-kun...
Since the quake ended, violence rules Kanto! But we won't bow to violence! Even if it's just us kids, we'll fight to survive!
Heh heh heh...
Man, sounds like a fun world!
Akira-kun!?
This Slum King's tough, right? Here in Kanto, you gotta fight to survive, right? I'm so thrilled I've got chills!
Akira-kun...
The Gedo Gang!?
Found ya, Ryu Takuma! Give it up!
Takuma-kun, who are these guys?
Scum who had nowhere else to go, so they drifted into Kanto!
What'd you say, you brat!?
Petty grown-ups who want to boss around us kids from the Quake Fort!
Gettin' too big for your britches!
Oh! Maybe the Gedo Gang will attack the Quake Fort for revenge!
All right! I'm coming with you! Let's protect the kids from the Gedo Gang!
Thank goodness... We made it back to the Quake Fort before the Gedo Gang.
But we can't let our guard down...
Yeah, I'll warn my friends.
In Kanto, us kids are the weakest animals around. But even weak little animals can survive if they band together!
Even if we lose today, someday we'll win! That's why we fight today!
This life my dad and mom gave their bodies to protect! I'm trusting it to Ryu Takuma!
Takuma-kun's our leader.\n\nHe called on the kids to band together so we can beat the grown-ups!
You'd better not leave the Quake Fort.
I just hope the Gedo Gang doesn't show up...
Takuma! They're here! The Gedo Gang!
There's so many of them, Takuma-kun!
Don't worry! There's a way to beat them! But we're not ready yet...
So we just gotta buy you time?
Akira!
Leave the dangerous stuff to me.\n\nI'm itching to cut loose anyway.
(The Demon blood flowing in Akira's body...\n\nHas its fighting instinct been set ablaze...!?)
Hold off the Gedo Gang for a little while!
We won't run from the Gedo Gang! We'll protect the Quake Fort!
Ready?\n\nOkay! NOW!
Whoaaa!
Eeek, help us!
We just dropped some rocks, but it worked better than I thought!
You look pleased, Takuma... But! What if the battle isn't over yet?
What's that...? The Dragons!? Oh no! The Slum King's with them!
Any Dragons that flee into the fort, you handle!
What? The Dragons are gonna flee into the fort?
The big man leading the Dragons... Is that the Slum King...!?
The guy they call the ruler of violence-ruled Kanto? This oughta be fun...!
...Jack is heading down from the fort!? Is he going to fight the Slum King!?
We have to help him!
We can't get through here for a while... Let's find another way.
...We can't get through here like this. Let's find another way.
What's wrong, Ryo?
Akira... Don't you hear it?
...I hear it!
It's true! I hear it too! Like voices echoing up from the bottom of the earth...!
It huuurts!
Heeelp meee!
I don't wanna diiie!
What on earth are these voices...?
...Come out, Jinmen!
Jinmen?
Kakkakka...! Even with your mind taken over by the human Akira Fudo, you haven't lost all your memories, eh, Amon the brave?
I'm not Amon the brave! I'm Devilman!
Kakkakka...! Either way! You'll be eaten by me anyhow... and become a pattern on my shell!
This world I reached while chasing you is truly delightful! A world collapsed by an earthquake...\n\nThe very last world of mankind, just as the Demons desire!
